title: Proposal Engineer – Energy Solutions
salary_note: No salary given on the careers page — page must say 'Competitive salary'.
description_text:
Our client is an established engineering and energy solutions company in Malta, providing technical solutions and services within the power and energy sector.
 About the Role
 Our client is looking for an experienced Proposal Engineer to join the On-Site Energy department.
 The role will be responsible for preparing accurate technical and commercial quotations and tender submissions for generator sets, energy systems, spare parts, overhauls, installations, testing, and commissioning.
 This position requires strong technical knowledge, commercial awareness, attention to detail, and the ability to coordinate effectively with multiple departments and suppliers.
 Key Responsibilities
 Review customer enquiries, technical specifications, drawings, bills of quantities, and tender documents.
 Prepare complete and accurate technical and commercial quotations.
 Obtain and compare prices from suppliers and subcontractors.
 Calculate equipment, labour, transport, installation, and commissioning costs.
 Prepare scopes of work, assumptions, exclusions, delivery periods, payment terms, and warranty details.
 Coordinate with Sales, Engineering, Purchasing, Logistics, and Operations to ensure accurate and timely proposals.
 Manage quotation and tender deadlines effectively.
 Respond to customer clarifications and prepare quotation revisions when required.
 Maintain accurate proposal and quotation trackers.
 Support the handover of awarded projects to the relevant operational teams.
 Ensure all proposals are commercially competitive while meeting technical and customer requirements.
 Requirements
 Technical qualification in Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial, Energy Engineering, or a related field.
 Minimum 3 years of experience in proposals, estimating, tendering, or technical sales.
 Hands-on experience preparing technical and commercial quotations is essential.
 Experience within power generation, generator sets, engines, energy systems, or industrial equipment is considered an advantage.
 Strong ability to understand technical specifications and prepare detailed cost estimates.
 Good commercial awareness and strong attention to detail.
 Excellent organisational and time-management skills.
 Proficiency in Microsoft Excel and Word.
 Excellent command of English, both written and spoken.
 Willingness to travel when required.
 What Our Client Offers
 Full-time employment with a Monday to Friday working schedule.
 40-hour working week.
 Opportunity to work within an established engineering and energy environment.
 Professional development and career growth opportunities.
 Exposure to a variety of technical and commercial projects.
 Ready to take the next step in your engineering career? Apply today and become part of a team working on innovative energy solutions in Malta.
